text_block_list.text: Coming to take a break at an open-air cafe—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... Sky-san.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What's up, Flower-chan?
All fidgety and restless.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Well...
Don't you think we're standing out?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? Nah, not at all~.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Look look, those two are so cute~♪
They're girls from Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
You're right, are they taking a break?
Knowing a place like this, so precocious~♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Auuu...
S-Should we leave soon?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Why would we~?
Our drinks haven't even arrived yet.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because...
The people around us are staring...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who said it before, right, Flower?
'I want to try coming here~'.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
'It looks so stylish and grown-up,
I'm so charmed by it~', wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I did say that, but...
Maybe it was still too early for me after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Humm...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Flower. Look, go ahead and check out
that person over there.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Over there...?
choice_data_list: (They seem to be staring at me...)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
See, looking pretty poised, aren't they?
Not flustered at all just because it's a stylish place.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's because that person
is a grown-up...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, what do you think makes
an adult an adult?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's an unshakeable sense of composure.
The key is having that calm reserve.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Composure...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! You wanna become
a grown-up lady, don't you, Flower?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
In that case!
Come on, try putting on a sharp, grown-up look!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A-A sharp look?
Um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *Hmph*...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah~... Nice, very mature.
Don't you think so too, person over there?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Eh... Really?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
See? Told you so.
You pull off the grown-up look nicely.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I see, so right now, I'm...
looking like a grown-up♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup. So let's take it easy here.
The breeze feels so nice, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No no! We still have training after this,
so only until the time we planned at first!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~?
...Did I give her a bit too much confidence~?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: S-Sky-san?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Maybe not that.
Well then, try giving a big smile!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That might feel more like
a mature lady, maybe.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Then...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Like this?
*Grin*...♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yup yup, super duper cute~☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Sky-san, are you by any chance teasing me...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Course not~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, here come our drinks!
You've gotta welcome them with a sharp look!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Eh, wah wah...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *H-Hmph*!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wait, Sky-san~!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nyahaha~☆
